name: Runway
shortDescription: Video generation and editing. Pricing page loaded; a free tier was not clearly confirmed.
longDescription: Runway generates and edits video. The site resolved at runway.com (from the older runwayml.com host). The pricing page returned HTTP 200 with a lot of content, but a free tier was not cleanly extracted, so it stays unconfirmed. One fetch of the help center returned 403. We did not create an account.
bestFor: Generating or editing video for a game or a stream
notIdealFor: A confirmed free plan from this check
strength: The pricing page lists video generation and editing from $12 per month.
weakness: A free tier was not clearly shown on that page, so it stays unconfirmed.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).
